resources.string: Forward every incoming SMS to the number you choose. Simple, offline, and on your phone.
To start, allow SMS receive and send permissions
Enter the number with country code, like +98 or +36.
Allow permissions first, then send a test message.
Enter the destination number with country code.
Allow SMS receive and send permissions.
Turn on forwarding and save the settings.
Samsung: open App info, tap Permissions, then allow SMS. If blocked, use the three-dot menu and enable Restricted settings.
Xiaomi: open App info, tap Other permissions, then allow SMS and Autostart if shown.
If Android still blocks SMS, reopen the app after changing permissions in system settings.
Forwarded messages are sent from your SIM and may cost SMS charges. Message text is not uploaded to the internet.
All required permissions are already allowed.
A real SMS will be sent to %1$s and carrier charges may apply.
